chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to us, from my grandfather, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),
regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Guide us the Straight Path»
He said: It is the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) and the conscious knowledge of him,

and the proof that it is the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) is His saying, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And indeed, he is in the Foundation of the Book, for us, certainly, Ali, the wise.»
And it is the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) in the Foundation of the Book, in His saying, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Guide us the Straight Path».
ai.seo_question: Who is identified as the 'Straight Path' in Shia interpretation of Surah Al-Fatiha?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq presents a distinct Shia interpretation where 'the Straight Path' (Al-Sirat al-Mustaqim) is identified not merely as a way, but as the person of Imam Ali (AS) and his gnosis (Ma'rifah). The hadith relies on a specific exegetical reading of Surah Az-Zukhruf (43:4), linking the word 'Ali' (High) to Imam Ali's title, thereby establishing his presence in the 'Umm al-Kitab' (Mother of the Book) as the ultimate guide. This highlights the Shia belief in the divine appointment and epistemological centrality of the Imams as the living embodiment of guidance.

en.basel-kadem: 3.	We were told by Ahmad bin Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by my father, from my grandfather, from Hammad bin Isa, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Guide us the Straight Path» [1:5].
He said: It is the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, and conscious knowledge of him,

and the proof that it is the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, is His saying, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And indeed, he is in the Foundation of the Book, for us, certainly, Ali, the wise.» [43:4] [1]
And it is the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, in the Foundation of the Book, in His saying, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Guide us the Straight Path».
